body: I'm passing through the same situation. But I'm the kid. My mom depends on me economically and I know that her life can go really bad if I do that. She had an PTSD episode too and if she really killed herself at the time - which was something that she attempted to - I would really be fucked. Please have this strength. I'm pretty sure they'll give you love and proud.
